items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Then the drummers that we had from time to time was Baby Dots and a boy named Happy. Yeah, I never did know any other names.

ctx.x: Then the drummers that we had from time to time was Baby Dots and a boy named Happy. Yeah, I never did know any other names.
There were two Happys, one was called Red Happy and the other Black Happy. Yeah. Happy Bolton. Benny, Benny the drummer. Black Benny.
Black Benny, yes. Black Benny, that's the real deal.
